agent_runtime.execution: three isolated git worktrees under persistent systemd user services

question: Can the existing K4 procedural-MCG codec be decoded in the MoE prologue into exact native NVFP4 E2M1 plus E4M3/16 operands and execute through mxf4nvf4 without a dense BF16/FP16 weight path?
candidate: K4 procedural-MCG sliding-window stream to packed E2M1 plus physical E4M3/16 residual scales to mxf4nvf4 m16n8k64
controls: stock NVFP4 kernel at matched topology and benchmark protocol
current P8 mxf8f6f4 endpoint as a quality/runtime boundary, not a speed control
hard_constraints: lookup tables at or below 4096 bytes
no dense BF16/FP16 weight materialization or weight matmul
protected selection, confirmation, final, and 28 reserved confirmation logits remain unopened
agent phase performs no GPU run or service modification

roles.name: kernel
roles.deliverable: separate fused P4 endpoint, structural tests, and bounded receipt

roles.name: codec
roles.deliverable: independent P4 pack/decode/reference verifier, deterministic fixture, and rate proof

roles.name: critic
roles.deliverable: adversarial ISA/runtime evidence matrix and falsifiable device gates

integration_order: review kernel diff against the frozen contract
cherry-pick only compatible focused commits with attribution
predeclare and run GPU bit/arithmetic closure
only after closure run integrated KLD, five-run determinism, and TP4 performance

acceptance_gates.structural: bit-exact reference, exact scale geometry and rate, explicit mxf4nvf4 path, no BF16/FP16 weight path
acceptance_gates.device: FC1 and FC2 finite numerical closure versus independent reference with preserved raw hashes
acceptance_gates.integration: kernel KLD equals pseudoquant within predeclared engineering interval on already-open conditional-fit data
acceptance_gates.performance: five cold TP4 runs with CUDA-graph parity; report prefill and decode separately versus stock NVFP4 and exact EXL3

claim_boundary: No native-P4, NVFP4-speed, quality, or serving claim is permitted from the agent phase alone.
